title: NIKE, Inc. (NKE) — Institutional Turnaround & Valuation Dossier
primer: NIKE retains $46.40 billion in FY2026 sales, yet its November 17 Investor Day cut FY2027 guidance to ~6% adjusted operating margins and $1.15–$1.35 adjusted EPS [1, 32]. Q1 FY2027 free cash flow turned negative at -$64 million despite collecting $684 million in tariff cash, leaving $2.70 billion in lease-adjusted net debt against $15.5 billion in endorsements [36, 37]. At $32.92 (26.3x FY2027E adjusted EPS), shares sit in Stage 4 above our $32.20 Base fair value [32, 42]. We assign REJECTED (TIER_0) for new money and issue EXIT_IMMEDIATELY on our 74.577319 Robinhood shares into 100% cash.
verdict_rule_summary: Stage 4 CAP_REJECTED trend combined with 26.3x FY27E adjusted P/E above our $32.20 Base Case fair value requires REJECTED (TIER_0) and zero new capital.
sizing_table_takeaway: Because NKE fails both valuation asymmetry (Base $32.20 below $32.92 CMP) and Stage 2 trend filters (Stage 4 CAP_REJECTED), new capital is REJECTED at TIER_0 (0% risk budget); the $27.00–$29.00 band is strictly a non-actionable reference (requiring <=$26.95 for 1.5:1 between $32.20 Base and $23.50 Bear) while the held position moves to EXIT_IMMEDIATELY.
holding_rationale: Nov 17 guidance cut FY2027 adjusted EPS to $1.15–$1.35 and pushed Pace savings into FY2029–FY2030. Q1 FCF fell to -$64M despite $684M in tariff cash, while shares broke into Stage 4 just $0.95 above the $31.97 52-week low. Portfolio cash sits at only 3.38% inside a 10-distribution-day US Downtrend. Sell all 74.577319 shares immediately via market order or tight 0.5% marketable limit to raise ~$2,455.09 cash.
